_source: Structured exploratory literature review v9, 17 August 2026 (VEGO_AI_Literature_Review_v9_PhD_Verified_Controlled_2026-08-17.pdf). Section locators are given per entry. Measured figures come from reports/generated/exp006|007|008. Paper figures come from the supplied MAS4Models submission draft.
streams_title: Six streams — each governs part of the lifecycle
streams_sub: Concept matrix from the review: what each stream asks, and what it leaves open for governed judgment in agentic assessment.
streams_foot: Concept matrix condensed from structured review v9 §11.1. Each “leaves open” is a residual limitation of the reviewed work — not a claim that the field contains nothing further.

streams.name: Learning to defer / reject option
streams.establishes: When to route a decision to a human — uncertainty, expert performance, cost, selective risk.
streams.leaves_open: usually treats the expert's response as a terminal label.

streams.name: Mixed initiative & human-centred AI
streams.establishes: Who acts and who controls — initiative timing, transparency, correction, override.
streams.leaves_open: does not specify a reusable judgment object.

streams.name: Explanatory debugging & disagreement
streams.establishes: How users correct reasoning, and how multiple human judgments relate — dissent, ambiguity, reconciliation.
streams.leaves_open: rarely addresses long-term scope and revocation.

streams.name: Provenance & documentation
streams.establishes: Where evidence and decisions came from — lineage, attribution, purpose, limitations.
streams.leaves_open: does not decide when to ask, or when reuse is permitted.

streams.name: Retrieval & external memory
streams.establishes: How prior evidence is retrieved — non-parametric access over versionable sources.
streams.leaves_open: similarity alone grants neither authority nor transfer permission.

streams.name: Domain & guideline adaptation
streams.establishes: How knowledge moves across contexts — source–target comparison, local validation, transparency.
streams.leaves_open: not tailored to granular human judgments inside agent pipelines.

streams_notes:
Six streams — don't read them out.

Make ONE point: every stream is strong at one checkpoint and silent at another. Deferral knows when to route but treats the answer as a terminal label. Mixed initiative manages control but defines no reusable object. Provenance records lineage but never decides when to ask. Retrieval finds similar cases but similarity is not permission.

That pattern is what forced the framework on the next slide: I needed to see the handovers, not the topics. (~55 sec)
framework_sub: The unit of analysis is not a paper and not a topic — it is one expert ruling, and the five checkpoints it must pass from the moment an agent hesitates to the moment someone claims the ruling still holds elsewhere.
framework_foot: Coding is single-researcher synthesis over the current core corpus; inter-coder reliability is not yet estimated, and the formal searches are not yet executed. Structured review v9 §11–12.
ceilings: Streams that are strong at eliciting a judgment are weak at keeping it. The correction is captured, then the reasoning behind it is discarded.
Streams that are strong at storing are weak at licensing. Retrieval fires on similarity; nothing checks whether this ruling may govern this new case.
Each governs part of the lifecycle. The contribution opportunity is the connection between them, not a missing isolated algorithm.
framework_notes:
This is the centre of the talk — the classification framework CL7 asks for.

The move that made it work: stop classifying papers by topic, and instead follow ONE expert ruling through five checkpoints — trigger, ask, record, reuse, prove. Each column is a governance question.

Now read DOWN the columns. That is aggregation, and it is where the gaps become visible. The two dashed lines are the finding: ASK→RECORD and RECORD→REUSE are the weak handoffs.

Say the caveat out loud: this is my coding of the corpus I have read, single-researcher, no inter-coder reliability yet. Running the formal searches may change a cell — that would be a real result, not a failure. (~85 sec — most important slide)
gaps_scope: Six residual gaps — each with a matching contribution hypothesis

gaps.evidence_basis: Deferral and active-learning work supplies routing methods, but not a policy combining uncertainty, consequence, disagreement, novelty, reuse value and queue state at fragment and pattern level.

Feedback systems capture corrections and annotation systems capture labels; the joint representation of decision trace, rationale, evidence, scope, authority and outcome is not established for agentic modelling assessment.
Provenance and contestability are well motivated, but operational rules for validation tiers, conflicts, supersession, expiry, revocation and claim-specific authority are missing.
Retrieval augmentation provides retrieval, but not permission. The missing mechanism combines semantic retrieval with hard governance gates and advisory use.

gaps.which_sq: C5 + C6 · Transfer Ladder · Leakage-Safe Harness
gaps.evidence_basis: Adaptation research motivates local validation, but the transfer properties of individual expert judgments and the correct frozen-store evaluation design remain open.

gaps.statement: Construct validity of the variability distinction
gaps.evidence_basis: “Substantial” versus “occasional” mixes validity with frequency language, and may obscure guideline mismatch, ambiguity and distinct error types.

gaps_notes:
Six gaps, six matching contribution hypotheses — C1 to C6.

Framing matters enormously here: each gap is a thin or empty region of the grid you just saw. Gaps come from the findings, not from the conclusion — that is the course's rule and it is also just good science.

Avoid the lazy framing that this area is unstudied — deferral and provenance plainly are studied. The defensible gap is the INTEGRATION: connecting intervention, representation, governance, memory and transfer into one traceable loop for variability exploration.

And be explicit: C1–C6 are design and research hypotheses. They are not implemented, and not empirically beneficial, until artifacts pass tests and independent evaluation. (~65 sec)
chosen_gap: The gap is integration, not an isolated missing algorithm.
chosen_gap_why: Mixed initiative already manages initiative; deferral already allocates cases; provenance already encodes lineage; retrieval already surfaces evidence; adaptation already models shift. What is unresolved is how to connect them into one traceable loop: request judgment selectively, capture it at the reasoning level, govern it as a versioned lifecycle object, reuse it only as scope-filtered advice, and evaluate it across a frozen leakage boundary.
